specs.title: [ka] the five sentences alone: which open the Video tool with the plan said, which are chat

annotations.description: intent-mv24-plan-mode-ka: "შექმენი 24-წამიანი მუსიკალური კლიპი." opened the Video tool in music-video mode (the panel shows it), but the storyboard plan POST /api/film/storyboard carried musicVideoMode=false — the board is planned with the mode from BEFORE the sentence (components/studio/OmniStudio.tsx:4647 reads videoMode from the render closure; the open step at ~8995 calls createStoryboard right after setVideoMode).

intent-exact-297-ka: "ვიდეო ზუსტად 29.7 წამი უნდა იყოს." alone is a chat message (the model answered; no Video tool, no plan). lib/agent/intent.ts needs a make-verb before a length opens the tool; the bare constraint sentence has none.

annotations.description: storyboardApproval revision 4 · fingerprint 231be4cb4fab371a (= fingerprintBoard(board))

storyboard-mismatch-retry: After a revision_mismatch the error card's Retry plans a NEW storyboard (POST /api/film/storyboard planOnly) for the user to approve again; the refused dispatch is never re-sent (orchestrate stayed at 1, assemble at 0). Message shown: "the storyboard changed after it was approved (revision 2 · 0…".
